details.after:
No new jobs met both suitability and current-posting verification requirements on 2026-09-11. Completed six search queries and ten posting-page access attempts, plus one employer vacancy-list check, within budget. Coverage included Ireland BI/reporting, Dublin analyst roles and graduate analytics programmes. Leads were checked against both supplied duplicate lists. Closed postings, inaccessible primary descriptions and unsupported eligibility prevented delivery; this bounded pass does not establish that no suitable jobs exist.

Rejected leads:
Davy — MI & Reporting Data Analyst, requisition 236BC30528: the linked Workable page returned no readable JD; a retry failed. The aggregator describes relevant Power BI/Snowflake work but asks for 2–3 years, exceeding the confirmed Associate Analyst tenure; training cannot automatically count. Not fully verified. [Application page](https://apply.workable.com/davy/j/236BC30528)
Optum / UnitedHealth Group — Data Analyst, requisition 2383172, Dublin/Letterkenny: search result appeared recent, but the employer posting returned 404 on opening. Requirements and application availability could not be verified. [Employer posting](https://careers.unitedhealthgroup.com/en/job/dublin/data-analyst/34088/99709554080)
iCIMS — Data Analyst, Dublin: opened page explicitly states that applications are no longer accepted. [Posting](https://careers.ta.com/companies/icims-2-d6017e9a-2785-453d-88cb-9348700e91b7/jobs/66655515-data-analyst)
ComReg — Data Analyst, Dublin: employer page explicitly states the position is closed. [Employer posting](https://www.comreg.ie/vacancy/data-analyst/)
Kepak — Data Analyst Graduate Programme 2026, Dublin: opened listing states applications are closed; programme start was 7 September 2026. This is distinct from the previously delivered operations role. [Posting](https://ie.linkedin.com/jobs/view/kepak-data-analyst-graduate-programme-2026-ireland-at-kepak-group-4311122379)
Allianz Ireland — Data Analytics Graduate Programme, Dublin: requires work authorisation covering the entire 36-month programme and an achieved or expected 2:1 degree. Neither eligibility condition is established by the supplied profile; the reported semester result is not a final degree classification. [Posting](https://ie.linkedin.com/jobs/view/data-analytics-graduate-programme-at-allianz-ireland-4461743847)
Cognizant — Data Analyst (Intermediate and Senior): search-level screening found a minimum five-year experience requirement, unsupported by the profile; not advanced to posting verification. [Employer posting](https://careers.cognizant.com/latam-es/empleos/46247/data-analyst-intermediate-and-senior/)
Previously seen roles resurfacing included Kepak Operations Data Analyst, EY AI & Data Graduate, Fanatics Data Scientist I, AIB Junior Quantitative Risk Analyst, FedEx and Analytic Partners; excluded as repeats.

Workspace consolidated on 10 September. Daily search and the personal dashboard now share application records. Today’s live job discovery has not started; historical postings need rechecking before use.
